name: shared-test-vectors

metadata.description: Overrides the @nx/vitest-inferred target's `inputs`; the first six entries are the inferred defaults re-declared, because setting `inputs` replaces them. vector-tree.test.ts checks that every vector file is loaded by some test, so it reads every *.test.ts under apps/ and libs/; without them, deleting the last test that loads a file would replay a cached pass. The vector files themselves arrive through ^default: this project's `default` named input adds {workspaceRoot}/test-vectors/**/*. That is an input glob rather than an implicit dependency on the test-vectors project, because the Docker builders copy only apps/ and libs/, and a dependency on a project they do not have breaks their project graph.

schema-export.description: Write test-vectors/schema/vector-file.schema.json from the Zod schema in src/lib/format.ts. A test fails when the committed file differs.
